name: Printable PDF
title: A page as a printable PDF: an HTML page, one page or .md of a task, or one of its chats, laid out again for Letter or A4, from the PDF section of an HTML page's Share menu, from an item's own menu on a task's page, or by asking, with a notice when it is ready

events.page_pdf: You pressed PDF in a page's Share menu, or in its menu on a task's page
events.chat_pdf: You pressed PDF in a chat's menu on a task's page
events.asked_for_pdf: You asked Rouh in a chat for a page as a PDF

permissions: opens a page of your workspace in a headless Chromium on Rouh's server, with only the page's own folder and public https, and writes the PDF into the same folder beside the page
reads a chat's messages and the cards it drew when you ask for that chat's PDF from its menu on its task's page, and writes the PDF into that task's folder
tells you in Rouh's notifications when the PDF is ready, and the phone if the notice is left alone, as every notice does
touches.remove: Turn the switch page_pdf off on its row in Evolution, Mutations: the Share menu has no PDF section, the items on a task's page have no menu, and print_page makes nothing; the chats, subtasks and checked pages on a task's page keep their menus without the PDF section. To remove it for good revert night 11's and night 12's commits (rouh/page_pdf.py, rouh/web/page_pdf.py, the print_page tool, the PDF section of the Share menu in index.html, runs.js, app.css and menu.js, the items' own menus on a task's page (objectindex._item_line, _chat_line, _subtask_dots, taskpage.js, taskItemPdf and taskChatAct in cards.js, taskbrowser.css, page_pdf.make_chat), the /files/ download in notices.js and cards.js, and this manifest). PDFs already made stay in their task folders until deleted.
